title: Palo Alto Networks agrees to buy Applied Compute, which helps companies customize open-weight AI models, for $4.5B in stock; it was valued at $3.25B this month (Kate Clark/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Kate Clark / Wall Street Journal: Palo Alto Networks agrees to buy Applied Compute, which helps companies customize open-weight AI models, for $4.5B in stock; it was valued at $3.25B this month — Startup was founded last year by former OpenAI researchers and specializes in customizing open-weight AI models
